entry.title: goatbuilder cannot name the download surface to update from
entry.what: update (and the behind-version notice) reads the release a goatnet serves at get.<site_id>.<site_dns_zone>/goatbuilder/. It looks at GOATBUILDER_UPDATE_URL, then --site (named from the site's group_vars), then the surface the last successful update used. None of them named a surface that serves goatbuilder for this machine.
causes: the first update on this machine was run without --site, and GOATBUILDER_UPDATE_URL is not set
the site named with --site has no ops/ansible/group_vars/<site>_hosts/ in the checkout goatbuilder was run in
the site does not serve goatbuilder (goat_get_goatbuilder_enabled is not true in its group_vars)
no goatbuilder release is built for this operating system and architecture
fixes: goatbuilder update --site <site>   (a goatnet that serves goatbuilder)
run it from a goat checkout, or pass -C <checkout>
